title: Generative AI, Pragmatics, and Authenticity in Second Language Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and synthesizing existing literature that evaluates AI models using cultural surveys, story-telling, and situational completion tasks to identify Western-centric values, norms, and stereotypes applied to non-Western contexts (e.g., Arabic, Asian, and Eastern European cultures).

Analyzing prior studies that assess generative AI's pragmatic competence across various languages using Gricean maxims, speech act evaluations, and discourse completion tasks, revealing an Anglocentric reliance on English sociopragmatic norms.
